messages:
sec-oncall: cred-scan flagged an AZ storage key in a Dataflow job stdout (high confidence). found token-like string in logs — need immediate revoke and rotation. link to finding: https://scanner.internal/findings/12458

maria-sec: thanks — can you paste the redacted log line so we can scope blast radius?

sec-oncall: here's the redacted snippet we pulled (redacted):
```
2026-03-22T15:02:11Z INFO Upload failed, AZURE_STORAGE_KEY=AZk...eKp==, container=my-backups
```

ben-infra: which pipeline/job is that coming from? owners tagged?

nathan-dev: that's from nightly-uploader df-job id df-2026-03-22-backup-stream. owners are @nathan-dev and @ben-infra — i'll pause the pipeline now.

tony-sre: i've put the job into maintenance mode and drained workers. removing the env var from CI/CD will be my next step.

maria-sec: immediate checklist: 1) revoke the exposed storage key in Azure 2) rotate Vault secret(s) that wrap the key 3) search logs + storage for any suspicious downloads 4) open an incident ticket and notify legal if exfil suspected

sec-oncall: created INC-2026-1223 and set severity=P1. assigned leads and linked the scanner finding. https://redwood.inc/INC-2026-1223

ben-infra: azure cli to regenerate keys (run as infra-admin):
```
az storage account keys renew --account-name myaccount --key primary
```
we'll rotate both primary and secondary and invalidate the old ones.

nathan-dev: Vault path affected: `secret/data/infra/azure/backups` (kv-v2). i'll write a new version with the new key and update the job to read the latest version instead of hardcoding.

maria-sec: good. please also rotate any CI tokens that may have been using the same env var. add a short note to the incident with which repos/services changed.

audit-bot: quick-scan complete: no external IPs pulled objects from `my-backups` in the past 48h. two internal agent IPs (10.4.12.8, 10.4.12.9) wrote objects during the nightly window. saving logs to INC-2026-1223.

tony-sre: observability action: enabling fine-grained audit for storage account and adding a short retention for the audit logs. will also add a saved query for `AZURE_STORAGE_KEY` exposures in stackdriver/bigquery.

nathan-dev: PR opened to remove plaintext key and switch to MSI (managed identity): https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/458 — tests green locally, will land after rotating secrets. also updating Dedicated deploy manifests.

ben-infra: completed key regen in Azure and revoked old keys at 2026-03-22T16:05Z. updated the incident with operation IDs.

maria-sec: confirm Vault rotation done? we need the new version in production before we unpause the job.

nathan-dev: Vault write completed, CI deploy updated to read new secret version, job redeployed in maintenance to smoke test. no crashes.

maria-sec: great. next steps: 1) finish deploy to prod 2) run post-rotation log sweep 3) draft postmortem with root cause: credentials emitted to logs by uploader when error path printed env vars. include recommended dev guardrails (no printing envs, add secret masking in logging lib).

sec-oncall: will update incident and track the postmortem. closing this thread when INC-2026-1223 has the postmortem and action items verified. thanks all :thumbsup:
